approvedDesignText:
Add repeatable `--field <name>` and `--field-id <id>` options to `gh project item-list`.

Behavior:
- Command help includes a realistic repeated selection example, e.g. `gh project item-list 1 --owner "@me" --field Status --field Priority`.
- The two selection options are mutually exclusive. Supplying both produces a clear flag-validation error.
- Either selection option conflicts with explicit output formatting (`--format`, including JSON and its jq/template variants). The command fails clearly instead of ignoring selections or changing structured output.
- With no selected fields, item-list output and request count remain unchanged.
- The initial item-list response supplies the first page of project field definitions. When fields are selected and that page indicates more definitions, fetch the remaining pages, merge them with the returned first page, and resolve against the complete list. Do not make a field-resolution request when the first page is complete, and never make an additional field request when no fields are selected.
- If retrieval of any additional field-definition page fails, return a useful error before table rendering; no partial table is produced.
- `--field` matches project field names case-insensitively. A missing name fails with the requested name and available field names. An ambiguous match fails with matching field IDs, sorted deterministically, and directs the user to `--field-id`.
- `--field-id` matches exactly. An unknown ID fails with available `name (id)` candidates.
- Repeated entries within one allowed option are retained in exact requested order, including repeated selections.
- The base columns remain `Type`, `Title`, `Number`, `Repository`, and `ID`; selected columns are appended in requested order and use each resolved field’s canonical name as header.
- For each requested column, look up the item’s field value exclusively by that resolved field ID. Never use field name or response-list position. Missing, unsupported, or unknown field-value variants render as empty cells.
- Render supported values for people: direct text/date/single-select; numbers without avoidable formatting noise; iteration and milestone titles; labels, users, reviewers, and pull requests as comma-separated names/logins/URLs; repository as URL.
- Normalize every selected-cell value by removing carriage returns and replacing each newline with a space before table rendering.
- Resolve all selections before rendering so invalid/ambiguous input never produces a partial or misleading table. Existing structured export remains unchanged.

Tests cover help/parsing and conflicts, complete-field pagination only when selections require it, pagination failure without output, case-insensitive/unknown/ambiguity diagnostics with deterministic IDs, exact ID resolution, ID-based value matching, requested order/repetition, supported rendering with CR/LF normalization and blanks for absent/unknown variants, formatted-output rejection, and unchanged no-selection behavior.
